scope: Separate local catalogue of names plus four existing portrait intent scalars; list/create/rename/explicit-update/delete and draft-only load; no source identities, anchors, rectangle, candidate, review, engine dispatch, photo apply or ordinary crop preset conversion.
manifest_policy: Exact 20 payload files plus this self-excluded manifest. No git commit/push by source writer. Old portrait-crop freeze remains historical.

source_checks.whitespace: git diff --check and explicit EOF/trailing-whitespace scan for all 20 payload files passed.
source_checks.json: This manifest generated and parsed as JSON; no application JSON changed.
source_checks.python_ast: Not applicable: no Python product source changed.
source_checks.execution: No tests, build, compile, typecheck, inference, product imports, app/browser execution, installs, downloads or new Codex task.
source_checks.independent_review: Parent static review found first-initialization directory replacement/reset race. Repaired with anchored no-follow mkdirat/openat, ancestor permissions/ownership checks and exclusive canonical initialization; independent re-review pending. Authored fixtures remain UNRUN.

limitations: No runtime, numerical, photographic, performance, storage-crash or UI acceptance is claimed.
Linux-only app-local persistence; non-Linux fails explicitly unavailable.

Atomic old/new canonical recovery; unknown schema/corrupt/missing existing catalogue never defaults or migrates. Interrupted first empty initialization intentionally fails closed and needs manual inspection.
Lost/invalid write receipt is unknown; unchanged snapshot cannot unlock potentially delayed write. Pending native I/O is not falsely timed out; stuck operation may require external diagnosis/restart.
Catalogue validates intent only. Existing planner remains final authority; every photo needs its own measured anchors and new reviewed candidate.
Batch/cohort transfer, automatic crown detection, arbitrary-rotation composition, ordinary flips and ordinary crop-preset conversion excluded.
